hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */backend/*.py) root="${f%%/backend/*}/backend"; cd "$root" || exit 0; out=$(uv run ruff format "$f" 2>&1 && uv run ruff check --fix "$f" 2>&1 && uv run mypy 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; };; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */apps/*.ts|*/apps/*.tsx|*/packages/*.ts|*/packages/*.tsx) root="${f%%/apps/*}"; root="${root%%/packages/*}"; cd "$root" || exit 0; out=$(pnpm exec biome check --write "$f" 2>&1 && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; };; esac; }
